author: john_masefield
text:
A NOBLE MIND

I have a mind so noble that it is sad to think how few
Men see its beauty; how little understand my kind of thought!
For as I walk among them with my thoughts in silence deep,
They know not me nor what spirit goes within my breast.
Then are they lonely, and I am lonely too: yet this makes
Me happier than were all their joys made mine, or mine theirs.
My heart feels glad when some young bird sings its morning song,
Or when the wind sways the oak-trees on the mountain side.
